Description: DATAPRL0: GREEN/RED amps present and populated
KWRDPRL0: required L0 PRIMARY keywords present
TELEPR: TELEMETRY extension present and populated
CAHKPR: CA_HK extension present and populated
EMSCIPR: EXPMETER_SCI extension present and populated
EMSKYPR: EXPMETER_SKY extension present and populated
DATTIMOK: Dates/times consistent (DATE-BEG/MID/END/ELAPSED)
NTPOK: NTP clock error < 100 ms
EXPTIMOK: EXPTIME finite/non-neg, matches ELAPSED
READOK: CCD read properly (not a smeared 6-6.7 s readout)
TEMP10: both CCDs within 10 mK of their temperature setpoints
TEMP100: both CCDs within 100 mK of their temperature setpoints
TEMP1000: both CCDs within 1000 mK of their temperature setpoints
GUIDEROK: guiding error RMS/bias within 50 mas
GDRCAMOK: guide camera not saturated
SEEINGOK: V-band seeing < 1.5 arcsec
ELEVOK: telescope elevation above 30 deg (ADC working range)
ETATMPOK: etalon chamber temperatures at their setpoints
AGITOK: agitator running above minimum speed
NOTJUNK: obs_id not in junk list
TARGETOK: pointing consistent with target/catalog RA/DEC
ASTROMOK: catalog epoch/equinox/rv/parallax/PM in physical range
COLOROK: catalog color present and in physical range
EMTIMEOK: exposure meter times consistent with shutter window
EMFLUXOK: exposure meter flux not saturated or negative
DEADPXOK: dead pixel fraction within limits on both CCDs
SATPXOK: over-exposed pixel fraction within limits on both CCDs
